strategy_roster.name: VWAP Stochastic Divergence
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low_prev(low,14) and roc(rsi(close,14),1) > 0 and adx(high,low,close,14) > 25
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic and VWAP are outside the DSL, so bullish divergence is proxied by a 14-bar prior low with a rising one-bar RSI, gated by the documented ADX(14) > 25 entry and < 20 exit thresholds. ATR-multiple stops and the 5-minute timeframe have no field equivalent.

strategy_roster.name: Turn Around Tuesday on Steroids
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(close,2) < 0 and roc(close,1) < 0 and close > sma(close,200)
strategy_roster.notes: Two consecutive down days are approximated by negative 2-bar and 1-bar returns, confirmed by the documented SMA(200) trend filter; the exit is a close above the prior 20-bar high. The Sunday-start day-of-week gate is not expressible without a time field and is dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Demo GPT - Day Trading Scalping
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) > 0 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < open and roc(close,1) < 0 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: Two green bars with volume above the 20-bar average become a positive bar plus positive 1-bar return and volume_ratio > 1, with the mirrored red-bar exit. The open-versus-prior-close condition needs shifted opens; EMA(20), VWAP and Camarilla levels are reference-only and unused.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Volatility Contraction
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Donchian(20) breakout is only taken when the channel is contracted versus 2.0x the ATR(14), which stands in for the volatility-contraction pattern; the mirror prior-bar low is the exit. ATR-multiple stops and the 5-minute candle type are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Anomaly Counter-Trend
strategy_roster.notes: The long branch buys sharp drops using the documented 1% threshold over a 30-bar (30 x 1-minute) window, and exits once the window return turns positive. The documented 100/200-tick stop and target are price units, not percentages, so the reversion exit stands in.

strategy_roster.name: Parent Session Sweeps Alert
strategy_roster.notes: A sweep below the previous session low that closes back inside the prior range is expressed with 4 prior 15-minute bars (roughly one session); the long exit is a return to the prior range top. The MinRiskReward = 1 target and session-extreme stop are not fixed percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Skewness Commodity
strategy_roster.notes: The documented signal is a cross-sectional ranking of futures by return skewness with periodic rebalancing, which requires a multi-symbol universe rather than a single-symbol price series. No honest long entry can be derived, so the never-true guard is used instead of inventing one.

strategy_roster.name: Stop Loss Mover
strategy_roster.notes: This is a position-management utility that only slides an existing stop to break-even once high exceeds MoveSlPrice; it documents no market-derived entry signal (its single demo long is opened unconditionally at start). The never-true guard prevents fabricating one.

strategy_roster.name: Strategy Connectable
strategy_roster.notes: The template trades purely on externally supplied signals, so there is no market-derived long condition to translate and the never-true guard is used. The documented percent protection is kept verbatim as 2% stop and 4% target.

strategy_roster.name: Auto Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: Documented as attaching and trailing protective orders on positions that already exist, with no trade-opening logic at all. StopLoss 114, TakeProfit 35 and TrailingStop 6 are absolute price units, so no percentage fields can be filled.
